amended_tasks.label: CORE
amended_tasks.description: Establish Teaching availability as a normal authenticated KIWI application surface. Do not gate Teaching or ordinary Teaching capabilities by development-user allowlists or generic runtime feature on/off flags. Unimplemented capabilities remain absent until their owning delivery implements and accepts them.

amended_tasks.label: CORE
amended_tasks.description: Enforce a no-generic-feature-toggle product rule for Teaching. High-stakes marking, impromptu tests, resits, external integrations, and future Teaching capabilities become available through their owning implementation/qualification/authority contracts rather than independent enable/disable feature flags.
